conversations_source_check.name: conversations_source_check
conversations_source_check.value: ("conversations"."source_kind" = 'datasource' and "conversations"."datasource_id" is not null) or ("conversations"."source_kind" = 'file' and "conversations"."datasource_id" is null)

skills_scope_check.name: skills_scope_check
skills_scope_check.value: ("skills"."scope" = 'global' and "skills"."datasource_id" is null) or ("skills"."scope" = 'datasource' and "skills"."datasource_id" is not null)
